scope: Existing dormant WF-C12-008 complete-tenant reader authorization and schema acceptance; no source mutation or DB execution

conclusion.answer: Yes. A correctly selected tenant context under a non-superuser/NOBYPASSRLS role can still hide same-tenant roots through an applicable restrictive SELECT policy. Current tick validates context and capability, not visibility completeness.
conclusion.counterexample: Keep organizations visible and HRM enabled; apply an effective restrictive USING(false) policy to the eight fact streams, or hide a whole disconnected offending component. All root pages can validly exhaust empty; dense result starts MATCHED with zero counts, sweep commits its opaque token, and tick can record MATCHED/lastCompletedAt when lease and attempt remain valid.
conclusion.counterexampleEvidence: Source-derived with official PostgreSQL policy semantics. Not executed against a database in this review; no claim this exists in deployed policy.
conclusion.contractQualification: Caller owns authorized reader and scoped read authorization; staging docs explicitly limit MATCHED to completed visible-tenant sweep. This preserves prior bounded acceptance. Authorization alone does not imply complete tenant visibility; full C12 acceptance needs a declared and verified complete-selected-tenant reader profile.
conclusion.priority: P2 acceptance/integration gap before any full-tenant completion claim or runtime activation; no proven active production defect
conclusion.additionalRisk: SQL table references are generally unqualified. A preflight must bind the objects actually resolved by those queries, not only inspect same-named public tables; search_path/temp shadowing and views must fail closed or be excluded by the authorized profile.

existingEvidenceLimit.sweepFixture: Selected hand-written tables deliberately omit FKs, use artificial tenant_isolation policies, then apply the real operations-state/index migration. This proves selected mechanics, not complete production schema/ACL/policy/trigger compatibility.
existingEvidenceLimit.eligibleRoster: Separate roster-health refuses row_security_active on its two aggregate tables. This strategy cannot simply be copied to fact reads because the intended fact reader must be subject to tenant RLS.
existingEvidenceLimit.runtime: Dormant; no new route/scheduler/activation needed for the proposed acceptance work.

readerProfile: Actual relation OID/schema/name and ordinary relation kind for every resolved source/dependency; no view/temp shadow.
ENABLE and FORCE RLS, owner and effective current role attributes, inherited role memberships relevant to policies; selected app.org_id and bypass off within the same authorized transaction.
Complete applicable SELECT/ALL policy set: permissive/restrictive, PUBLIC and inherited roles, USING expression and referenced function identity/definitions. Policy name alone is not evidence.
Schema USAGE and required SELECT columns; reader has no business-fact DML path. Keep control lease/state/cursor privileges and authorized cross-tenant roster visibility separate.
Read-only RepeatableRead snapshot, bounds and statement/transaction deadlines; verify no unsupported profile allows checkpoint advancement.
schemaObjects: Projected column names/types/nullability/date and enum assumptions; current Prisma schema plus migration-derived checks, uniqueness, FKs and delete actions.

Eight organizationId/id C-collated keyset indexes and approval-group C index from 20261005193000; validate actual index definitions/readiness, not names only. Operational due/attempt/org index separately.
Enabled immutable, append-only, insert-subject and legacy-fact guards on relevant fact/snapshot tables; trigger function bodies and later replacements, not only initial CREATE TRIGGER.
Historical membership agent-deletion cascade/guard from 20261006120000 and assignment transfer-window guard from 20261006150000 must be retained; do not revert accepted PR594/C7 semantics.
Migration ledger/provenance distinguishes full historical replay from generated Prisma schema plus explicitly selected policies/guards.

policyProvenanceExamples.workdays_events: 20260806160000 normalizes earlier MTM policies to tenant OR explicit bypass; bypass must remain off for reader.

requiredInventory.inventoryQualification: Direct query surface and concrete provenance anchors, not an exhaustive transitive migration/trigger inventory or proof of actual staging ACLs. Later migration definitions must be resolved in order.

smallestMeaningfulNextSlice: Build one finite source-bound schema/reader-profile manifest from the actual required tables and repository policy definitions; preserve generated-schema and selected-migration provenance.

In an isolated fixture only, reproduce valid-context hidden offending root versus visible control, including inherited-role restrictive policy and true empty tenant. Assert the former cannot earn complete-tenant MATCHED/checkpoint after a fix; retain baseline negative.

If runtime enforcement is included, reject unsupported effective SELECT policy/role/relation profiles before root enumeration, using approved exact profile definitions rather than arbitrary SQL equivalence or a caller Boolean. Restrictive-policy absence alone is insufficient if permissive policy itself is narrowed.

Test canonical complete-tenant profile positive, selected/foreign tenant isolation, missing/narrowed SELECT policy, missing FORCE RLS, missing SELECT privilege, ordinary-table/search_path shadow refusal, and incomplete visibility of schedule dependencies.

Every refusal must leave business facts/cursor unchanged; attempt may record bounded INCOMPLETE/backoff. Lease/version/attempt fencing remains mandatory. Verify profile drift/concurrency assumptions explicitly; no untested claim that RepeatableRead alone freezes DDL/role authorization.
Reuse existing dense/fairness/overflow/fencing evidence for unchanged bytes. Run only uncovered profile/schema cases; no new reader architecture, scheduler, grants or business rules.
nonSolutions: Counting through the same RLS-filtered reader cannot detect invisible disconnected roots.
FORCE RLS does not mean full tenant visibility.
row_security=off is not a bypass; it refuses policy-filtered reads and is not a positive complete-tenant fact reader check.
Do not fix by granting BYPASSRLS, disabling policies or using a superuser fact reader.
remainingExternalOrSeparateCriteria: Historical empty-DB replay still blocked at missing api_keys/P3018/42P01; no marking applied or schema repair authorized by this review.
Representative staging data/query plans/density/timeouts and complete ACL/trigger verification remain separate from a synthetic manifest.
Real collector destinations, retention/access, operational alert delivery, scheduling/activation and signed-device work are not proven or modified.
WF-C12-008 remains PARTIAL; ledger stays 84/161 DONE, 77 open.

primaryReferences.supports: Invisible rows are omitted; role inheritance and FORCE/owner/BYPASS semantics; row_security off refusal.
Permissive OR and restrictive AND, role/command applicability.
